<!--''''''-->(Japanese: '''チェアたろう''' ''Chairtarō'') is a recurring character in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. He is an announcer who hosts events in various different [[region]]s.

==History==
[[File:Chairtarou Alola.png|thumb|left|170px|Chairtarō in Alola]]
==={{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}===
Chairtarō makes his debut in ''[[PS012|Wake Up—You're Snorlax!]]''. There, he hosted a [[Bicycle]] race that {{adv|Red}} participated in. The prize for the competition was {{PDollar}}1,000,000, which Red managed to obtain, only to be forced to spend in order to feed his newly caught {{p|Snorlax}}, [[Snor]].

==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}===
In ''[[PS060|Breath of the Dragonair Part 1]]'', Chairtarō is seen hosting the [[Vermilion City|Vermilion]] Beach Monster-Wave-Riding Contest that {{adv|Yellow}} participated in. The prize for the contest was a {{p|Dragonair}} capable of crossing over the seas, but it was stolen by [[Lance]].

==={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===
In the [[Hoenn]] region, Chairtarō serves as the announcer for [[Pokémon Contest]]s. In ''[[PS217|Mind-Boggling with Medicham]]'', he is seen hosting a [[Rank (Contest)|Normal Rank]] Contest in [[Verdanturf Town]]. In ''[[PS223|I More Than Like You, Luvdisc I]]'', he is seen hosting a Super Rank Contest at [[Fallarbor Town]]. In ''[[PS232|Always Keep Whiscash on You for Emergencies]]'', despite the area being flooded due to the awakening of {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}}, Chairtarō is seen hosting a Hyper Rank Contest in [[Slateport City]]. When Chairtarō falls into the water, a passerby {{tc|Swimmer}} saves the announcer and chastises him for hosting a Contest despite the danger.  

==={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===
In ''[[PS350|Boogying with Buneary]]'', Chairtarō appears as an announcer for [[Pokémon Super Contest]]s.

==={{MangaArc|Black & White}}===
In ''[[PS483|Special Delivery]]'', Chairtarō appears as an announcer for the [[Pokémon Musical]].

In ''[[PS512|Hallway Hijinks]]'', Chairtarō appears as an announcer for the {{un|Pokémon League}}

==={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}===
In ''[[PS531|Unforgettable Memories]]'', Chairtarō was seen in a flashback hosting [[Hugh's sister]]'s birthday.

In ''[[PS534|Choir Tournament]]'', Chairtarō appears as an announcer for the [[Autumn Choir Tournament]] alongside [[Roxie]].

==={{MangaArc|X & Y}}===
In ''[[PS549|An X-cuse to Come Out and Play]]'', Chairtarō was seen in a flashback as an announcer alongside [[Gurkinn]] for the Junior Tournament.

==={{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}}===
In ''[[PASM05|The Announcement and the Prize]]'', Chairtarō appears as an announcer for a tournament taking place during a festival held in [[Iki Town]]. It was also revealed that his current lack of clothes was due to him getting robbed by [[Team Skull]] the previous day. When {{adv|Sun}} battled [[Guzma]], Chairtarō was harassed by {{tc|Team Skull Grunt|Grunt A}}, who claimed that Chairtarō was biased against Guzma.

==Trivia==
*The line revealing Chairtarō's name in ''[[PASM05|The Announcement and the Prize]]'' was edited in Viz's English translation of the manga, leaving him without an English name.
